answer: Ridge-Linked Session Continuity. Each agent session inherits a unique fingerprint chain seeded at first contact; every later action must extend the chain its predecessor signed, and a fork is flagged as duplicate lineage. Attacker cost is maintaining one continuous chain per claimed identity — forks collapse, so clones must buy fresh seeds and lose history. A violet flag marks forked seeds; residual ember value decays on flagged chains, making duplication visible.
